ingredients.name: Salicylic Acid
ingredients.description: Beta-hydroxy acid (0.5-2% OTC) that penetrates pores to dissolve comedones and excess oil. Conditionally recommended by AAD 2024 acne guidelines for mild acne and oil control.

ingredients.name: Benzoyl Peroxide
ingredients.description: Antimicrobial that kills C. acnes bacteria, mildly comedolytic and reduces inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. Strongly recommended by AAD 2024; start with low-strength (2.5%) wash-off formulas to limit irritation.

ingredients.name: Retinol
ingredients.description: Topical retinoid class (retinol/adapalene) that normalizes cell turnover, prevents clogged pores and smooths texture and scarring. Cornerstone of acne care per AAD/EuroGuiDerm; use at night with sunscreen and moisturizer due to dryness risk.

ingredients.name: Azelaic Acid
ingredients.description: Comedolytic, antibacterial and anti-inflammatory dicarboxylic acid (10% OTC) that also fades post-acne dark marks. Conditionally recommended by AAD 2024; well suited to sensitive and darker skin tones.

ingredients.name: Niacinamide
ingredients.description: Vitamin B3 that regulates sebum, calms inflammation, supports the barrier and fades marks. Listed by the National Eczema Association as soothing; consensus ingredient for acne, oiliness, redness and dark spots.

ingredients.name: Glycolic Acid
ingredients.description: Alpha-hydroxy acid that gently exfoliates, refines texture and pores, and helps dark spots. Dermatologist-consensus ingredient for acne, dark spots and maintenance exfoliation in tolerant skin.

ingredients.name: Zinc PCA
ingredients.description: Zinc salt of pyrrolidone carboxylic acid that controls sebum, limits shine and provides mild antimicrobial support for oily and blemish-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Tea Tree Oil
ingredients.description: Plant-derived antibacterial agent with clinical trial support for mild acne; use in low concentrations in cleansers or spot care due to irritation risk.

ingredients.name: Green Tea Extract
ingredients.description: Antioxidant rich in EGCG that reduces sebum, calms inflammation and defends against environmental damage. Supported as adjunctive care in acne dermocosmetic reviews.

ingredients.name: Sulfur
ingredients.description: Keratolytic and mildly antibacterial mineral traditionally used in cleansers and masks to dry excess oil and unclog pores in mild acne and oily skin.

ingredients.name: Hyaluronic Acid
ingredients.description: Humectant that attracts and holds water for deep, oil-free hydration. Recommended by AAD for dry skin and suitable as lightweight hydration for barrier-impaired and oily skin.

ingredients.name: Ceramides
ingredients.description: Skin-identical lipids that rebuild the moisture barrier, lock in water and keep irritants out. Core ingredient for dry and eczema-prone skin and maintenance barrier creams.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.description: Humectant that draws moisture into the skin and supports barrier recovery. Listed by both AAD (dry skin) and the National Eczema Association as a soothing eczema-friendly ingredient.

ingredients.name: Squalane
ingredients.description: Lightweight emollient that mimics skin's natural oils to soften without clogging pores. Non-irritating hydration for dry, eczema-prone and maintenance routines.

ingredients.name: Shea Butter
ingredients.description: Rich emollient high in fatty acids that deeply moisturizes, softens rough skin and reduces dryness. Listed by the National Eczema Association among soothing butters for eczema-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Petrolatum
ingredients.description: Occlusive gold standard that seals in moisture and protects a damaged barrier. Recommended by AAD for dry skin and by the National Eczema Association as highly effective for eczema (ointments > creams > lotions).

ingredients.name: Urea
ingredients.description: Humectant and mild keratolytic (typically 5-10% in moisturizers) that softens rough, scaly dry skin and improves water binding.

ingredients.name: Lactic Acid
ingredients.description: Gentle alpha-hydroxy acid and humectant that smooths flaky dry skin while drawing in moisture. Listed by AAD among effective dry-skin moisturizer ingredients.

ingredients.name: Colloidal Oatmeal
ingredients.description: FDA-recognized skin protectant that soothes itching and irritation and forms a protective barrier. A mainstay for eczema and dry, itchy skin.

ingredients.name: Panthenol
ingredients.description: Pro-vitamin B5 humectant that hydrates, soothes and supports barrier repair in dry, sensitive and eczema-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Jojoba Oil
ingredients.description: Emollient wax ester that mimics sebum to soften dry skin without heavy grease. Listed by AAD among effective dry-skin moisturizer ingredients.

ingredients.name: Dimethicone
ingredients.description: Barrier-forming silicone that locks in moisture and shields sensitive, dry skin from irritants. Listed by AAD for dry skin relief.

ingredients.name: Allantoin
ingredients.description: Soothing agent that softens rough skin, calms irritation and supports healing in dry and eczema-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Aloe Vera
ingredients.description: Soothing plant gel that cools irritation and provides light hydration. Listed by the National Eczema Association among calming ingredients for eczema-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Centella Asiatica
ingredients.description: Cica extract that calms redness and irritation and supports barrier recovery in sensitive and eczema-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Vitamin E
ingredients.description: Emollient antioxidant (tocopherol) that softens dry skin and helps defend against environmental damage. Listed by the National Eczema Association among eczema-friendly moisturizer ingredients.

ingredients.name: Clay (Kaolin/Bentonite)
ingredients.description: Absorbent minerals that draw out excess oil and impurities from pores to reduce shine in oily skin; use 1-2x weekly to avoid over-drying.

ingredients.name: Zinc Oxide
ingredients.description: Mineral sunscreen filter providing broad-spectrum UV protection with mild oil-absorbing effect. Daily SPF 30+ is recommended by AAD for all skin types including acne-prone and oily skin.

ingredients.name: Vitamin C
ingredients.description: Antioxidant (ascorbic acid derivatives) that brightens tone, supports collagen and boosts photoprotection alongside sunscreen. Dermatologist-consensus ingredient for maintenance glow and dark spots.

ingredients.name: Peptides
ingredients.description: Signal peptides that support firmness and elasticity as part of a healthy-skin maintenance routine.
